changes.before: "Romani Talisman": A star-shaped medal worn by nomadic Romani in the late 17th century to protect themselves from the dangers of travel. A warding spell is engraved on it.
changes.after: "Gypsy Talisman": A star-shaped medal worn by nomadic Gypsies in the late 17th century to protect themselves from the dangers of travel. A warding spell is engraved on it.

changes.before: "Jeanne d'Arc, granddaughter of Lugot the wine merchant, is declared a witch and sentenced to death in the name of the Church."
changes.after: "Wine merchant Lugot's granddaughter, Joan of Arc, is declared a witch and sentenced to death by order of the Church."
changes.note: Joan naming plus source-faithful tightening to recover TT2 packing efficiently.
